home_description: Start your next project with {framework}, {toolchain} and {language}. A foundation with server-side rendering and light and dark themes.
home_seoTitle: SolidJS Boilerplate | Web applications with SSR
siteContent_homeFeatures: SolidJS Boilerplate brings together server-side rendering, file-based routing and TypeScript to start a web application. The structure includes interface components, light and dark themes, and pages in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Page content arrives in the initial HTML, while JavaScript adds interactive controls.
siteContent_homeUsage: Use this project as a starting point for SolidJS websites and applications, or as a reference for integrating SSR, translated pages and automated tests. The repository contains the source code and guides for development, architecture and SEO. When building a product from this foundation, adapt its content, public details and policies to your own requirements.
siteContent_aboutDescription: Learn about the open source project maintained by Éverton Toffanetto and its web application features.
siteContent_aboutIntro: SolidJS Boilerplate is an open source project maintained by Éverton Toffanetto. It provides a foundation for building web applications with SolidJS, TypeScript and Vite+, with source code available on GitHub under the MIT license.
siteContent_aboutPurpose: The project brings together the initial integrations for an application: server-side rendering, route organization, translated content, themes and automated tests. This website demonstrates the foundation in use. Its examples and documentation help explain the project choices before you adapt it for another product.
siteContent_aboutSource: The repository is the reference for installation, development commands and implementation details. Its guides cover architecture, testing, SEO and server error handling. The license permits using and modifying the code under the terms published in the repository. Review those terms and the configuration before deploying a product built from this project.
siteContent_contactDescription: Find the repository and public maintainer channels for SolidJS Boilerplate.
siteContent_contactIntro: For questions about SolidJS Boilerplate, start with its public GitHub repository. It contains the source code, documentation and issue tracker for reporting problems and suggesting changes related to the project.
siteContent_contactIssues: Before opening an issue, check the README and existing discussions. To report a problem, describe the observed behavior, the expected result and the steps needed to reproduce it. Include the relevant environment and dependencies so others can investigate. Do not publish passwords, tokens, personal data or configuration files containing secrets.
siteContent_contactMaintainer: Éverton Toffanetto maintains this project. His public GitHub profile is linked on this page. Issues are public and can be read by anyone, so choose what to include with that visibility in mind. The project does not publish a response deadline or offer a contracted support channel through this demonstration.
siteContent_privacyDescription: Learn how this demonstration uses language and theme preferences and where to find its public channels.
siteContent_privacyIntro: This page describes the privacy features observable in the source code of this SolidJS Boilerplate demonstration. Its public pages do not provide account registration, checkout or a form for submitting personal data.
siteContent_privacyPreferences: The interface uses cookies to remember the language and theme preference. The language also appears in the page address, such as /pt, /en or /es. These preferences keep the presentation consistent between visits. You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings; a choice may then stop persisting on your next visit.
siteContent_privacyHostingTitle: Accessing the site and external links
siteContent_privacyHosting: When you access this site, your browser sends technical information needed for the HTTP connection to the hosting infrastructure. This notice does not establish a retention period for that infrastructure's logs. Links to GitHub and other services lead to websites with their own policies. Information posted in a public issue is available to other people on that service.
siteContent_privacyQuestions: Use the contact page to find the maintainer and the project's public channels. Before reusing this boilerplate in another product, review this notice against the hosting setup, connected services and data that product will process. The information on this page applies to this demonstration and does not define the practices of applications built from it.
